aboutSection.introHeading: Crafting Generational Homes with Integrity & Architectural Precision
aboutSection.introParagraph: At VSHN Builders, we believe a home is more than walls and a roof—it is a sacred sanctuary where your family’s memories take root. With 20 years in active building construction and more than 24 years of combined founders’ engineering expertise, we bring deep local Chennai knowledge, uncompromised structural rigor, and clear transparent costing to every project.
aboutSection.story: Founded in Chennai, VSHN Builders was established to bridge the gap between architectural elegance and trustworthy construction practices. Starting with North Chennai and expanding rapidly across Chennai metropolitan and Tamil Nadu districts, our team of seasoned civil engineers, architects, and master craftsmen has delivered over 164 turnkey residential projects on time and within budget.
aboutSection.founderMessage: Our name V-S-H-N represents our founding pledge to you: Value for money in every specification, complete Satisfaction of our customers, Hope for every family to own a pristine custom home, and on-time Delivery without compromise.
aboutSection.founderExperience: 24+ Years Combined Structural & Turnkey Execution Experience
aboutSection.mission: To deliver high-performance, architecturally superior, and structurally resilient homes that exceed client expectations through transparent execution, certified materials, and punctual milestone delivery.
aboutSection.vision: To be the most respected and trusted residential builder and architectural design studio in Chennai and across Tamil Nadu.

testimonials.review: Building a home in North Chennai was a lifelong dream for us. VSHN Builders delivered our house in exactly 10 months as promised. Their transparency in material brands—using genuine Tata Tiscon steel and Ultratech cement—gave us total confidence. Every evening we received photos of the site progress. Highly recommended!

We opted for their Premium Package for our Anna Nagar villa. The attention to detail in the 3D elevation, teakwood work, and concealed plumbing is extraordinary. The founders themselves visited the site weekly to supervise the structural curing and concrete pours. Exceptional engineering standards!

What sets VSHN Builders apart is their tagline: YOUR DREAM HOME. OUR RESPONSIBILITY. They literally took care of everything from plan approval to the final coat of paint. There were zero hidden charges and no surprise escalations. Harish and his team are true professionals.

faqs.answer: Our packages are comprehensive turnkey solutions. They cover complete foundation excavation, RCC earthquake-resistant frame, brick masonry, plastering, interior and exterior painting, certified electrical and plumbing piping, brand-name sanitaryware and CP fittings, doors, windows, and kitchen granite platform. Note: Final pricing depends on project specifications, soil depth, custom elevations, and individual material selections.
faqs.question: What is included in the ₹2,350 / ₹2,450 / ₹2,650 per sq. ft. packages?

faqs.answer: We divide the construction project into 6 distinct milestones (Foundation, Plinth, RCC Slabs, Masonry & Plastering, Finishing & Services, Final Handover). Each stage has a strict contractual timeline with dedicated site supervisors and daily WhatsApp site progress reports.
faqs.question: How do you guarantee on-time completion?

faqs.answer: Yes! Our architectural and civil engineering team prepares municipal-compliant 2D architectural drawings, structural stability certificates, and assists you through the municipal plan sanctioning process.
faqs.question: Do you help with CMDA / Chennai Corporation building approvals?

faqs.answer: Absolutely. We offer complete flexibility. If you want Deluxe package framing but want to upgrade to Premium Italian marble flooring or specific bath fittings, we calculate the exact difference with zero hidden markups.
faqs.question: Can I customize materials within a specific package?

faqs.answer: Yes, while our primary operational base is in Chennai (Tondiarpet, Anna Nagar, OMR, ECR, Tambaram, etc.), we execute selected residential projects across Tamil Nadu districts including Kanchipuram, Chengalpattu, Vellore, Tiruvallur, and Coimbatore.
faqs.question: Do you work outside Chennai in other parts of Tamil Nadu?
